note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: payments
datasets.select: SELECT id,biz_order_no,pay_order_no,amount,pay_channel_code,status,pay_success_time,create_time FROM pay_order WHERE biz_user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay_order WHERE biz_user_id=?

datasets.name: refunds
datasets.select: SELECT r.id,r.biz_order_no,r.refund_order_no,r.refund_amount,r.status,r.refund_channel,r.create_time FROM refund_order r JOIN pay_order p ON p.pay_order_no=r.pay_order_no WHERE p.biz_user_id=? ORDER BY r.id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_order r JOIN pay_order p ON p.pay_order_no=r.pay_order_no WHERE p.biz_user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
